candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey get convulsion now. Pikin no don get convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Pikin fit drink or breastfeed. Pikin no dey vomit everything. Caregiver talk say pikin never get ear discharge before and e no get am now. Pikin no dey feel pain for ear. Pikin no get pus wey dey comot from ear. Pikin get swelling wey dey pain am for back of ear. Fever don dey for 2 days. Pikin no get rash for body. Dem no see any bacteria cause for the fever. Area wey pikin dey get high malaria risk. Malaria test dey available. Malaria test talk say e no get malaria. Pikin no cough or get catarrh wey follow measles. Pikin never get measles for last 3 months. Dem no see any clear reason for the fever. Pikin eye no red. Pikin no get catarrh. Pikin neck strong. Temperature na 38.0°C. Pikin na 18 months. Pikin get cough or e dey struggle to breathe. Pikin no get diarrhoea. Pikin get ear problem. Pikin get fever. Dem count pikin breath for one minute. Pikin chest no dey go inside when e dey breathe. Pikin calm as dem dey check am. Cough don dey for 3 days. Pulse oximeter no dey available. Pikin no dey get wheeze again and again. Pikin dey breathe 35 times for one minute. Pikin dey get stridor when e calm. Pikin no dey wheeze.
